customer: Hello, I had booked an appraisal for my convertible since we're going down to one car in our household, but something came up and I may need to move or cancel it. Could you tell me how that works, and whether I'd lose my offer? Thank you so much.
agent: Thanks for reaching out! You can reschedule or cancel your appraisal appointment online, or by replying to your confirmation text, up to 2 hours before it starts, and canceling is free. If you reschedule, your offer stays in place only if the new time is on or before the offer's expiration date (see "How long is my offer good for?"). And if you happen to miss the appointment without canceling, your offer stays valid until it expires and you can book again.
